base_settings_source: training_config.json; original Standard LR/SVM, unscaled RF
initial_B: base/ balanced for three families; robust-none for LR/SVM
tuning_B: LR C=.1 or 10; RF trees=200 or depth=12+leaf=3; SVM C=10 or gamma=.001. Initial Validation winner fixes weight/scaler.
primary: Validation per-Batch macro-F1 equal-weight mean over batches 7 and 8
eligibility: Other four gas pooled Validation mean F1 must not fall more than .03 below same-family B baseline; focus gases are IDs 4 and 6.
tie: Within .005 of best primary: larger min(Toluene F1,Acetaldehyde F1), larger minimum-class recall, larger pooled macro-F1, smaller Validation Batch SD, then fixed trial order. Margins are exploratory rules, not significance tests.
selection_pool: Only condition B. One representative per family; global close joint candidates are representatives within .005 of highest primary.
evaluation_gate: Freeze selection and selected model bytes before any 9–10 predictions.
